releaseNotes: Turbo Deep OCR speeds up the remaining Smart Search work without rebuilding or discarding completed index progress. The deep stage no longer repeats the image document probe or PDF embedded-text extraction already completed by the fast stage. OCR working images are reduced to a practical document-reading size, idle pauses between micro-batches are shortened, and capable 8+ core phones can process up to three OCR files at a time while 6-7 core devices use two and smaller devices remain sequential. PaddleOCR stays limited to two inference threads per call to avoid excessive CPU pressure. SQLite checkpoints, Pause/Resume, unchanged-file reuse, Search by Name, Search Content, Connect to PC, Transfer Status, reminders, sounds, and previous Smart Life behavior are preserved.
